messages.content: That won't work — the refund reason needs to say exactly 'cracked lid'.

The CLI only accepts predefined reasons (`damaged`, `late`, `wrong_item`, `not_received`, `other`) — free-text like "cracked lid" isn't supported, and there's no update command. RF-0001 is currently set to `damaged`, which is the closest match.

To get it updated to exactly "cracked lid," you'd need to do it directly in the backend system — I can't do that from here.
